title: How many paid moderator FTE a developer question-and-answer network's council requests for 2027 across its nine topic sites, when community review items reach the paid team only after volunteer reviewers have left them for 72 hours
subdomain: retention-cohort-lifetime-value-modeling (trust and safety at a developer Q&A network: each site's volunteer reviewer pool, closed to new members since review access became invitation-only, carried forward on survival by tenure read from a left-truncated roster, and the reviews a retained reviewer delivers when the inbox outruns the pool, set against the 2027 inbox the question plan implies)
prompt_shape: a committed FTE request with each of nine sites' whole-FTE need and the distance from finance's envelope, a stacked monthly chart of paid review hours by site from January 2024 to December 2027 with the envelope drawn across, and three tables (each site's share of flags first acted on within 24 hours in July, August and September 2026; each site's paid moderators' hours worked in the first three quarters of 2026; each site's January to September 2026 questions as a percentage of 2022's)

sources.origin: constructed for this task by task156/generator/build.py (seeded, deterministic) around a fictional Toronto-run developer question-and-answer network of nine topic sites, in the layouts of a review platform's daily inbox export and reviewer roster, an older review system's monthly queue workbook, a moderator tool's flag exports, a posts warehouse, a planning team's question plan, a WFM system's shift lines and an HR assignment history; no real organisation's records or person is depicted.
